expected_response.note: No registered bounded edit has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent under the affinity-first objective; incumbent parameters preserved.

failure_modes: Editing pointcloud_delta_A or teacher_neighbors to chase pair-kernel or joint-motion diagnostics would change a scalar that contains no pair-kernel or joint-motif term, so the expected affinity response is unsupported and could displace surrounding coordinates without benefit.

A region_index edit would concentrate attention on one landmark while the reproducible signals are distributed across many landmarks (turnover residuals at landmarks 00,01,04,07,08,16,17,19), risking unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates.

A temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend edit would impose a time-conditioned rule that the supplied continuous trends do not validate (extrapolation_allowed=false, polynomial_accepted=false, multiple sign changes), risking a null or reversed response.
Any temperature proposal would be an interface violation, not a research condition.
rationale: Retain the incumbent (D2_without_trajectory_static, pointcloud_delta_A=1.0, teacher_neighbors=4, mixture_temperature=0.5, teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2=4.0). The Analyst's most reproducible coordinate hypotheses are short-range pair-distance shell density (endpoint_effects:9/10/11 positive with positive_batch_fraction 1.0; branch_adjusted:86/87 and 240/241 positive with same_sign_batch_fraction 0.93) and coherent joint internal motion (branch_adjusted:74/76/151/153 negative with same_sign_batch_fraction 0.93-1.0). However, the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit), so no registered bounded edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) maps onto those observables. The available edits act on the pointcloud curvature, a single landmark's regional attention, teacher count, or a time-conditioned teacher blend; none is a pair-shell or joint-motion control. Directional evidence is also internally conflicting: increment contrasts reverse sign relative to endpoint contrasts for landmark_00_softmin (increment_effects:14 negative vs endpoint_effects:14 negative but occupancy3 increment_effects:15 positive vs endpoint_effects:15 positive), pair_kernel_2.5 (increment_effects:10 positive) versus pair_kernel_7.0 (increment_effects:13 negative), and shape_xx/shape_yy increments are negative (increment_effects:3/4). Continuous trends are observed-node linear with extrapolation_allowed=false, polynomial_accepted=false, and multiple sign changes (continuous:0-9), and curve_support reports legendre_runtime_allowed=false, so no time-conditioned rule is validated. Teacher agreement is only partial (information_audit top4_teacher_overlap 0.470, CI 0.427-0.515; compressed_choice_excess_fixed_RMS_A 0.081, CI 0.070-0.092), and innovation alignment does not translate into observed child score gain (joint_diagnostics:1 positive vs joint_diagnostics:2 negative). Decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available=false), so descendant credit cannot be resolved to final affinity benefit. Under the affinity-first objective, no permitted edit has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent, so retaining the incumbent is the correct choice. Temperatures (mixture_temperature 0.5, teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0) are immutable and are not proposed for edit.
